crossRefs.note: Israel said to Joseph, “Aren’t your brothers feeding the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them.” He said…
He said to him, “Go now, see whether it is well with your brothers, and well with the flock; and bring me word again.”…
He recognized it, and said, “It is my son’s tunic. An evil animal has devoured him. Joseph is without doubt torn in…
Jacob, their father, said to them, “You have bereaved me of my children! Joseph is no more, Simeon is no more, and you…
He said, “My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he only is left. If harm happens to him along…

translations.web: One went out from me, and I said, “Surely he is torn in pieces;” and I haven’t seen him since.
translations.bsb: When one of them was gone, I said: “Surely he has been torn to pieces.” And I have not seen him since.
translations.kjv: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:
